sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our order history for this part shows 5.17 EUR (po:4500013023-10) against 5.45 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014455-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Today you supply 80 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have factored your verified order history and volume increase into this offer; however, please understand that our detailed cost breakdowns are confidential and cannot be shared. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We welcome the 36-month commitment and have adopted the AS-14404 index clause to provide you with the requested planning certainty. Taking up your offer to pay faster in exchange for a better price, we have adjusted the payment terms to 30 days net to support this reduction. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 36 months: €5.47 per unit.

This Angebot is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We acknowledge your revised offer and the constructive step towards an agreement. 

As a reliable distributor, we are dedicated to supporting your material needs from our extensive range with first-class service. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your proposed 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, we can reduce our price to €5.36 per unit, with a contract term of 36 months, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This represents a further concession on our part to reach a mutually beneficial conclusion. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
